method: Sum compiler static self-frames along disassembly call graph; include tail-jump frames conservatively. Inlined code already belongs to containing frame. Callback edges use bound adapter and native-MMIO assumptions. Unknown runtime and external callback frames are excluded, not zero-cost.
maximum_chain_frames_live_together: Prologues allocate 640,1696,592,16 B; inspected direct call sites occur before matching epilogues.
excluded_unknown_callbacks: Any other supplied read32/write32 implementation instead of native helpers
exclusions: USB service glue and USB stack
IRQ entry hardware stacking, handlers and nesting
RTOS/task stack switching, if later added
